title: diag.6: GPS — UART health and baud detection
description: Count NMEA checksum failures on GPS UART. >10 consecutive failures: report DIAG_GPS_BAUD_MISMATCH. No bytes at all after 10s: report DIAG_GPS_UART_SILENT. Valid NMEA but no fix after 120s: report DIAG_GPS_NO_FIX with satellite count from GSV. Distinguishes wiring failure from indoor-no-sky from baud mismatch.
